page_title: STU 5-2 RBL | Stuttgart v RB Leipzig 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Sven Jablonski has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle as Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Chris Fuhrich will be replaced by Jovan Milosevic (VfB Stuttgart).
89' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) will replace Deniz Undav.
87' Substitution. Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart) in, Josha Vagnoman out.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) as he is replaced by Willi Orban.
84' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roberto Massimo (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Jamie Leweling.
84' Substitution. Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Samuele di Benedetto.
79' David Raum (RB Leipzig) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Sven Jablonski lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) is coming onto the pitch as Xaver Schlager cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Here is a change. Dani Olmo is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
75' 5 - 2 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom right corner.
71' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Nubel comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' A yellow card for a tackle by Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart). Sven Jablonski doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
67' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Christoph Baumgartner and he is replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
67' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolas Seiwald.
67' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
64' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
62' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
59' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is caught offside!
56' 4 - 2 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) makes the score 4:2 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Chris Fuhrich.
55' 3 - 2 Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
55' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes it short.
53' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) swings in a cross from the corner, but Janis Blaswich reads it well and gathers the ball.
52' The resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared.
50' David Raum (RB Leipzig) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
48' 3 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Josha Vagnoman and Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 3:1.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to RB Leipzig as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
45+5' Referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for RB Leipzig. Let’s see what happens!
45+5' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

45+3' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
45+1' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

45+1' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The linesman makes the right call and Stuttgart will have a corner.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends the corner into the box, but Janis Blaswich intercepts it and averts the threat.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

41' What a chance that is! Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
41' PENALTY APPEAL after Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
39' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
38' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Janis Blaswich.
34' Sven Jablonski couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) and blew his whistle.
32' 2 - 1 Gooal! David Raum takes over corner duties. Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it low into the middle of the net. 2:1.
32' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
30' 2 - 0 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the left post. It's 2:0.

29' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Janis Blaswich is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
28' That's unlucky! Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Janis Blaswich into left side of the goal.
25' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
24' The Stuttgart players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
23' There's a break in play and referee Sven Jablonski must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Stuttgart using VAR. This could be interesting!
23' That looked a certain handball by Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
22' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the corner kick.

22' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
21' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
16' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card for infringement.
13' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' Neat passing move from Stuttgart in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Flag goes up against Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' A dangerous looking corner kick from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared to safety by the defence.

7' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
5' The foul by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Sven Jablonski.
2' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half has just begun.
RB Leipzig will kick the game off.
Sven Jablonski will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
